## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run validate` finishes with **0 errors**, and `npm run cite-check` reports **0 fail**
- [ ] CANARY.md entry added in this same commit, under the current version block, grouped by kind
- [ ] Dates carry sources; nothing invented; contested topics use the `perspectives` block — each view cited and labelled, no verdict
- [ ] Sensitivity check: no figurative depiction of prophets or Companions, no AI-generated portraits, media licences whitelisted
- [ ] AI-assisted? Disclosed — content records carry a `provenance` block (`generated_by`), and commits carry the `AI-Agent:` / `AI-Model:` / `AI-Editor:` trailers
- [ ] i18n parity: Arabic and English ship together in this change (identical i18n keys, prose in both); `/ur/` is untouched — the Urdu edition is the founder's lane, so new strings are flagged for it, not written into it
- [ ] Layout check: nothing breaks, shifts or disappears on phone, tablet or desktop, and every page still reads with JavaScript off
